def main():
    import sys
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    t = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    result = set()
    for i in range(1, len(s) + 1):
        prefix_s = s[:i]
        for j in range(1, len(t) + 1):
            result.add(prefix_s + t[:j])
    print(len(result))
